statement_summary: Group CISO accountable; each covered entity designates its own security and privacy officials
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document common control inheritance annually
HIPAA sanctions documented by each covered entity
No BAA no PHI; intercompany BAAs reviewed on service change; subcontractor gate for BA divisions
Annual common control assessment and division samples
Six-year retention of security documentation
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Unique identities; no shared accounts
Role-based least privilege; purpose-approved access to another covered entity's PHI; no standing dual-zone access
MFA for all workforce; phishing-resistant for administrators and by 2027-06-30 for remote access
Service accounts owned, governed, workload identity or 90-day key rotation
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination; contractor auto-expiry
Quarterly access certification including privileged and service accounts
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM
Break-glass accounts per critical system tested quarterly
Vendor access only through PAM; no persistent tunnels
MFA for brokers and SaaS customer administrators
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
Each covered entity decides its own breach notices; BA divisions notify customers per BAA
Notification matrix owned by Group General Counsel; reviewed quarterly
Severity 1 to disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of materiality
Annual cross-division exercise including notification and materiality
Encrypt Restricted information at rest and in transit
Covered entity and purpose tags on every PHI dataset
Minimum-necessary protocol for routine feeds between covered entities
De-identify only by approved method and only where the customer BAA permits
Immutable separate-provider backups with quarterly restore tests
No Restricted data in AI tools without approval and a no-training BAA
Annual training, monthly reminders, quarterly phishing
Role-based training for data platform users
Approved generative AI tools only
Record patient conversations only with the consent state law requires
ASC emergency plans reviewed every 2 years and include a prolonged cyber outage
Decision support tools inventoried and input variables reviewed
No UM policy or model-assisted workflow without UM committee approval; documented individualized review
State insurance regulator list and contacts in the notification matrix
Customer notice register by BAA term
AI and product change gate (privacy, BAA, SOC 2 description)
